column1: This course is for anyone who would like to learn how to use their doodling skills in a practical way to upgrade their life and improve their results. column1: What Visual Thinking Templates are Included?
The following visual thinking templates are included as part of this course.

This visual thinking template works with the pain and pleasure principle to help spark the motivation you need to move you toward the attainment of your goals and objectives. It outlines a thought process you can use to help you find the internal motivation you need to help you get unstuck.

This visual thinking template is designed with the intention of helping you gain a high level of clarity about a specific goal that you would like to achieve. It outlines a thought process you can use to help you set more effective and inspiring goals that you are naturally motivated to pursue.

This visual thinking template is designed to help you progressively expand your comfort zone from an undesired reality to a more desired reality. It effectively outlines a thought process you can use to help you progressively expand your comfort zone in the pursuit of your goal.

This visual thinking template is designed to help you outline a very specific set of criteria to help you always make the most optimal decision moving forward. It outlines a thought process you can use to help you make more far effective decisions when facing troubling dilemmas.

This visual thinking template is designed with the purpose of helping you work through difficult emotions far more effectively. It outlines a thought process you can use to help you move from an undesirable state to a more desirable and empowering state that can help you achieve your desired goals and objectives.

This visual thinking template is designed to help you lay down a solid plan of action for the attainment of your goal. It outlines a thought process you can use to help you list down a set of steps and the potential obstacles that may stand in your way as you work toward accomplishing your goal. Moreover
column2: it helps you work through these steps in a fun an interactive way.

column1: This visual thinking template is designed with the purpose of helping you clarify your life’s vision. This visual thinking template is designed as an effective prioritization tool to help you pinpoint critical areas of focus for the attainment of your goal. It outlines a thought process you can use to help you determine where your main focus and attention must flow in order to achieve your desired goal in an optimal way.

This visual thinking template is designed to help you get a sense of your feelings and current emotional state when it comes to various aspects of your life. It uses a confidence scale as well as several emoticons to get a sense of how you’re feeling about your life and circumstances. It’s very much a foundational activity that can be used as a starting point for other visual thinking templates.
